name: Abu Ibrahim Ahmad ibn Muhammad
bio: Aghlabid emir of Ifriqiya from 856 to 863. He enlarged the Great Mosque of Kairouan and had its mihrab faced with lustre tiles, the oldest lustre tiles that are still in place.

milestones.event: Had the mihrab of the Great Mosque of Kairouan faced with lustre tiles from Iraq.
